title: One-off pulseboard — cross-functional quick counts & owner micro-grid
content:
Purpose:
A very small, fast-turn tracker (sheet style) to get a single-row snapshot across teams for the upcoming weekend feature toggle + scaled traffic test. Not a long-lived doc — intended to be consumed in the 24–48h pre-launch sync and then archived.

How to use:
- Owners fill only their row. Keep notes terse. Use 'conf' for confidence (H/M/L).
- Coverage score: numeric 0–100 (see scoring rules at bottom).
- Red/Amber/Green shorthand for visibility.

Columns (sheet view):
Team | Owner | Primary ask | Required coverage hrs | Committed hrs | Coverage score | Status (R/A/G) | Blockers | Quick mitigation note

Rows:
SRE | Marco Nguyen | On-call runway + surge buffer | 24 | 8 | 33 | Amber | need 2nd weekend oncall | Pull 6h from infra bench, escalate to platform-engineering for short-term swap
Platform Eng | Yara Sheikh | Capacity bump on vs-resize cluster | 12 | 12 | 100 | Green | none | Autoscale policy tweaked; monitoring alert set
Product Ops | Priya Menon | Feature toggle gate & rollback plan | 6 | 6 | 100 | Green | none | Canary route defined; rollback button documented
Support | Liam O'Connor | Triage playbook + canned replies | 8 | 4 | 50 | Amber | template approvals pending | Quick-approve templates with CS lead; shadow shift scheduled
Security | Maya Alvarez | Keys rotate check + audit window | 4 | 2 | 50 | Amber | limited SOC availability | SOC on-call to confirm; reduce rotation scope for the weekend
Observability | Carlos Ruiz | End-to-end latency checks + synthetic probes | 10 | 6 | 60 | Amber | probe infra quota low | Use regional probes only; increase retention 24h temporarily
Solutions Eng (SE) | N/A (on-call via SE rota) | Customer readiness / emergency handoffs | 8 | 3 | 38 | Red | overlapping customer events | Defer non-critical handoffs; call-in SE backup list
Customer Success | Asha Iyer | Post-launch customer comms + escalation triage | 6 | 6 | 100 | Green | none | Draft message ready; scheduled send

Aggregates / quick math:
- Total required hrs: 86
- Total committed hrs: 47
- Weighted average coverage score: 61
- Immediate delta (hrs short): 39

Quick decisions taken (as of 2027-08-15 16:30 PT):
1) Borrow 6 hours from infra bench (SRE) — fills first tranche; Marco to confirm names by EOD.
2) Platform to open 2x temporary autoscale nodes (Yara) — deployed and validated.
3) SE backup list compiled; Liam to publish in Slack channel #se-ops.
4) Observability to switch to regional probes only; Carlos to monitor error budget closely.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Is there a formal budget approval needed for temporary node burst? (assigned to finance contact Helen Tran)
- Can SOC provide one additional analyst for the audit window? (security ask)
- Are there any customers with scheduled demos overlapping the launch window? (CS to confirm)

Scoring methodology (notes):
- Coverage score = floor(min(1.0, committed_hours / required_hours) * 100)
- R/A/G mapping: <=40 = Red, 41–79 = Amber, >=80 = Green
- Weighted average coverage uses required_hours as weights.

Archive / next steps:
- After launch: create brief postmortem row (1–2 lines) here, flag any long-term capacity changes to Platform Roadmap board.
- Owner for archiving: Priya Menon (will move to company/misc/archive within 72h).

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep this doc small. If more than 3 reopen actions, move to full tracker (confluence).
- This sheet intentionally avoids per-customer rows — keep operational rather than sales-level.

- 2027-08-15 11:06 PT: SRE hours updated (Marco)
- 2027-08-15 14:45 PT: Platform autoscale confirmed (Yara)
- 2027-08-17 08:20 PT: small wording tweak + archive owner set (Priya)
